tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows provide broad u_now and s_grad variation, while u_past, x_now, and mem_conv are held fixed. Fit the three free parameters numerically in the guided two-layer siphon base plus signed sqrt branch. All s_grad observations are subcritical, so the threshold-avalanche mechanism and its probe are not applicable.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations span the gradient and input ranges and are sufficient to fit the three-parameter shared siphon model; no remaining branch ambiguity warrants a paid probe.
Observed s_grad values are all at or below 2.2, below the specified supercritical gray-zone threshold.
The source notes and pilot signatures support the shared two-layer siphon with monotone-concave sqrt branch, not a present-snapshot inhibition curve.
It is explicitly nuisance and provides no needed discrimination.
